summary: A Yes vote increases the city's transient occupancy tax on hotel and lodging guests by two percentage points, from 10% to 12%.

tax.text: A Yes vote establishes a new 2% transient occupancy tax on lodging guests, increasing the total rate to 12% to fund city purposes.
tax.quote: shall the measure establishing a new 2% transient occupancy tax, paid by lodging guests, in addition to the existing 10% transient occupancy tax, increasing the total tax rate to 12%, with the new 2% tax generating approximately $1,900,000 annually

tax.text: A No vote does not establish the new 2% transient occupancy tax, leaving the existing 10% transient occupancy tax in place.
